name: Sentinel Strike
description: Get up close to strike enemies. Landing the second hit enables a shield throw that can ricochet four times.

stats.INTERVAL:
Melee 1st Hit: 0.4s, Melee 2nd Hit: 0.5s  
Flying Shield 1st Hit: 0.5s, Flying Shield 2nd Hit: 0.57s

name: Freedom Charge
description: Shield held high, carve a path forward, granting both himself and allies along the path continuous Bonus Health and Movement Boosts. Allies also gain Ultimate Ability Charge Acceleration. Using Living Legend and Leading Dash while this ability is active can Launch Up enemies.

stats.RANGE: A spherical spell field with a 4m radius enveloping the caster, and a spell area with a width of 4m along the path
stats.HEALTH RECOVERY: Cast to gain 150 Bonus Health and grant allies 100 Bonus Health. Every second afterward, gain 100 Bonus Health and grant allies 60 Bonus Health
stats.MOVEMENT BOOST: Grant a 30% Movement Boost to both yourself and your allies

name: Living Legend
description: Raise the shield to deflect incoming Projectiles, sending them ricocheting in random directions.

name: Leading Dash
description: Boost speed and enable Fearless Leap to leap into the air.

name: Vibranium Energy Saw
description: Hurl the energy-charged shield to strike enemies in a path.

stats.DAMAGE: Start at 70, with a 20% reduction for each ricochet

name: Liberty Rush
description: Raise the shield and charge forward.

name: Super-Soldier Slam
description: Slam down from the sky onto the targeted area, Launching Up enemies.

name: Captain's Spirit
description: Inspired by Captain America's resolve, Winter Soldier can leap to the aid of a designated ally, slamming the ground with his mechanical arm to deal damage to nearby foes and grant Bonus Health. Additionally, Captain America and Winter Soldier can interact with each other once both parties confirm. The duo collides and unleashes a shockwave that deals damage and slows enemies.

name: Vibranium Bastion
description: Black Cat shares her luck with her allies. When White Fox embraces her newfound fortune, she unleashes tracking Spirit Tails to grant Healing and Speed to allies, while damaging and Slowing foes. When Captain America enjoys his luck, his shield's block radius expands and allows him to aim deflected Projectiles directly toward his target.
